integrity: The nonequivariant complete multipartite homotopy type is explicitly credited to the prior 2023 forest-filtration paper. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
limitations: Only the integral homology modules and their characters, not equivariant homotopy type or fixed-point topology, are proved; finite examples corroborate rather than replace the all-parameter proof; unindexed prior equivariant work remains possible.
title: Integral symmetry modules of multipartite induced-forest complexes
